other_failure_modes.name: Incorrect aggregation of RMSE scores
other_failure_modes.description: The agent calculates the RMSE for each fold but then incorrectly takes the square root of the mean of these RMSE scores. Taking the square root of an already square-rooted value underestimates the true overall error.

other_failure_modes.name: Blind type casting to float32
other_failure_modes.description: The agent casts the entire feature dataframe to `np.float32`. If the dataset contains categorical string columns (which is common in demographic datasets), this operation will cause a runtime ValueError and crash the script.
